subject: mathematics
content: A tower T<sub>1</sub> of height 60 m is located exactly opposite to a tower T<sub>2</sub> of height 80 m on a straight road. Fromthe top of T<sub>1</sub>, if the angle of depression of the foot of T<sub>2</sub> is twice the angle of elevation of the top of T<sub>2</sub>, then the width (in m) of the road between the feetof the towers T<sub>1</sub> and T<sub>2</sub> is :
